roles.title: Assign diagnostic roles
roles.description: Assign only the Uptime Kuma monitors that should participate in diagnosis. A monitor can have one role. Uptime Kuma Tags can prefill these selections when their Tags entities are enabled, but the confirmed mapping is stored locally in Network Diagnostics.

data_description.gateway: The local gateway/router whose reachability anchors local-vs-upstream diagnosis.
data_description.network_node: A switch, router, bridge, or other local infrastructure node that can have a parent and downstream children.
data_description.mesh_node: A wireless access point, mesh satellite, or similar node. Its response-time baseline can be compared with its parent and siblings.
data_description.fixed_client: A non-roaming client physically downstream of one local node. Two independent fixed clients behind a node provide stronger forwarding/backhaul-path evidence than one.
data_description.lan_control: An independent, stable local-LAN endpoint used to distinguish a gateway failure from the Home Assistant-to-LAN path.
data_description.ipv4_control: An external IPv4 reachability control. Two independent controls provide stronger evidence for a general IPv4 failure.
data_description.ipv6_control: An external IPv6 reachability control. Two independent controls provide stronger evidence for a general IPv6 failure.
data_description.dns_neutral: A DNS check independent of the local resolver or service being diagnosed.
data_description.dns_local: A DNS check through the local/router resolver path.
data_description.service_dns: A DNS check for a named external or local service group.
data_description.service_path: A non-DNS path/reachability check for a named service group, used to separate service DNS failure from service-path failure.
data_description.https_control: An HTTPS/application-layer control used with IP and independent DNS evidence to localize HTTPS-specific failures.

parent.title: Set parent for {monitor}
parent.description: {monitor} is configured as **{role}** ({position} of {total}). Select the infrastructure node directly upstream of it. Choose no parent only when the relationship is unknown or intentionally outside the modeled topology.

data_description.parent: The configured upstream dependency. Network Diagnostics uses this relationship to suppress downstream symptoms and calculate impact.

service.title: Name service for {monitor}
service.description: {monitor} is configured as **{role}** ({position} of {total}). Give related service DNS and service path controls exactly the same service name so they can be correlated.

data_description.service: A local display/group name supplied by this Home Assistant installation. It is not built into the integration source.

confirm.title: Review diagnostic model

error.duplicate_monitor_assignment: A Kuma monitor was assigned to more than one diagnostic role.
error.no_monitors_selected: Assign at least one Kuma monitor.
error.configuration_blocked: Correct the configuration blockers before saving.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Network Diagnostics instance is supported.
abort.uptime_kuma_required: Set up the official Uptime Kuma integration before Network Diagnostics.
abort.no_kuma_monitors: No usable Uptime Kuma monitors are currently exposed by Home Assistant.

init.title: Diagnosis and incident behavior
init.description: These settings control evidence freshness, incident confirmation, RAM-only adaptive response-time baselines, and compact incident retention. Raw Kuma measurements are not duplicated into a Network Diagnostics recorder.

data_description.stale_seconds: Maximum age of the freshest public Kuma heartbeat entity for each configured monitor.
data_description.failure_confirm_seconds: How long a new abnormal diagnosis must persist before opening an incident.
data_description.recovery_confirm_seconds: How long healthy evidence must persist before closing an incident.
data_description.baseline_window_minutes: Rolling in-memory window used for each eligible local node. Samples are not persisted.
data_description.baseline_min_samples: Fresh samples required before adaptive degradation analysis becomes available.
data_description.baseline_ratio: Current response time must exceed this multiple of the rolling median, in addition to the minimum increase and robust-spread test.
data_description.baseline_min_delta_ms: Minimum response-time increase above the rolling median before a value can be considered abnormal.
data_description.degradation_seconds: How long an adaptive response-time anomaly must remain abnormal before it becomes a degradation diagnosis.
data_description.incident_retention: Maximum number of compact completed incident records kept by Network Diagnostics.

configuration_required.title: Network Diagnostics needs configuration
configuration_required.description: Assign Uptime Kuma monitors to diagnostic roles and define any local parent relationships using the Network Diagnostics reconfigure flow.

configured_monitor_missing.title: Configured diagnostic monitors are missing
configured_monitor_missing.description: {count} configured Uptime Kuma monitor(s) can no longer be resolved. Reconfigure Network Diagnostics to replace or remove the missing monitor assignments.

invalid_configuration.title: Network Diagnostics configuration is invalid
invalid_configuration.description: The configured evidence model contains a blocking problem: {details}. Reconfigure Network Diagnostics before relying on root-cause conclusions.

stale_provider.title: Uptime Kuma evidence is stale
stale_provider.description: One or more configured monitors are no longer receiving fresh state through Home Assistant. Check the official Uptime Kuma integration and the monitors it exposes.
